notes.title: Update 1.16
notes.content: Balancing powers and minor bug updates

notes.title: 1.15 Sucker Punch VR Update!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Wield the new Robo Fist!
[*]Overwhelm your enemies with the new Slicer Wall power!
[*]Play new rule sets.
[*]Experience the updated Nutz Wood level in the Arcade.
[*]Expert drone balancing
[/list]
...and some minor bug fixes and balancing.

notes.title: Welcome to the Arcade!
notes.content:
[h2]A NEW game mode in Sucker Punch VR![/h2]
[list]
[*] Progress through the levels, battling progressively more difficult drones!
[*] Defeat each boss drone and push your high score up the leaderboard!
[*] Holding the highest score will take cunning strategy and lightning reflexes.
[/list]

[h3]Welcome to your next challenge![/h3]

[previewyoutube=0h9TAKcYvxA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 1.12 Sucker Punch VR update!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Easier to see Scores!
[*] Timed challenges now available in Training and Multiplayer
[*] See your record vs each drone
[*] Improved punching! Hear, feel, and see the cubes fear your fists
[*] Play in the updated Playground Arena
[*] …and some minor UI updates, power balancing, and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: New Subway Arena!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Arena! Subway
[*] Winter arena = de-Holidayed, now it's Winter Wood
[*] Leaderboard update! New weekly leaderboard. Daily challenges add up for the week and a weekly champion is crowned! We'll be praising that champion for that week for all to behold!
[*] New timed daily challenge variant. A new challenge to mix things up for the new challenge leaderboards.
[*] Challenge scoring re-work. Updated how the scoring works to make it better.
[*] Bug fixes and polishing.
[*] Lots of little stuff.
[/list]

notes.title: Sucker Punching (with) friends is so much fun!
notes.content:
[b]Sucker Punch VR 1.10 update brings an overhaul to the Multiplayer match experience![/b]

Notes:
[list]
[*] Multiplayer menu and match creation overhaul (no more room codes!)
[*] A new glove! (Lancers Gauntlet)
[*] New power! (Lance of Heros)
[*] Bug fixes & polish
[/list]

[previewyoutube=3Te4NYiV6ss;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Ogre has arrived!
notes.content:
Unleash the power of the '[i]Warp Bash[/i]' with a new glove '[b]The Ogre[/b]'!

Those pesky force fields getting in your way? Bash cubes straight through anything between you and your opponent.

Update Highlights:

[list]
[*]New Glove: The Ogre
[*]New Power: Warp Bash
[*]Haptic options added to settings
[*]Balancing & polish
[*]Bug fixes and such
[/list]

[previewyoutube=D3pX9JQss8w;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:
